io.github.antonyrag:ragleap-rag 0.9.0 发布, Java port of ragleap-rag's core RAG pipeline: connection
        pooling, embeddings (7 providers), pgvector storage (dense,
        sparse, hybrid RRF search), retrieval, and generation
        (streaming, structured output, provider fallback, vision
        captioning) - plus standalone utilities (chunking,
        sanitization, guardrails, cost tracking, evaluation scoring,
        structured-output validation, observability hooks).
        Independently versioned from the Python ragleap-rag package
        (see https://pypi.org/project/ragleap-rag/) rather than kept
        in lockstep - this port does not yet have parity with the
        Python package's full surface (only pgvector of its 6 vector
        backends, no query rewriting, no conversation memory, no
        ingestion pipeline). Every module here is genuinely tested;
        most of the core pipeline is live-verified against real
        Postgres and Ollama, documented per-class where it is not.

io.github.yuku123:z-msg-ws 1.2.0 发布, Z-MSG 实时接入层: 一条 WebSocket 端点 + 一次性 ticket 握手鉴权 + topic 订阅模型。
        实现 z-msg-api 的 RealtimeTransport，被 z-msg-core 的 RealtimePublisher 自动收集，
        业务侧除配置 ticket 密钥外零改动；站内信/IM/业务事件共用一条连接。
        跨节点广播或 SSE 兜底请另写一个 RealtimeTransport 实现，本模块不冒充这些能力。

Update your dependency to implementation("co.silverpush:silverpush-admob-adapter:2.0.0"). Version 1.0.1 contains no code; it only forwards to the new coordinate, so an existing build keeps resolving with no change. The new coordinate is a major version: the Parameter configured against the ad source in your AdMob or Ad Manager console is now a key the adapter looks the ad unit up with, rather than the ad unit itself, so the console entry has to be updated as well or the ad source will stop filling.

io.tesseraql:tesseraql-s3 0.19.1 发布, Optional S3 (and S3-compatible) object store for attachments (roadmap Phase 30
    slice 2): an S3BlobStore on AWS SDK for Java v2 (Apache-2.0), selected by
    tesseraql.object-storage.provider: s3 and discovered through the BlobStoreProvider ServiceLoader
    (the PdfEngine idiom). One module covers AWS S3 and every compatible store (Cloudflare R2, Ceph,
    Backblaze B2) via endpoint/region/pathStyle/checksumMode. Apps that do not store blobs in S3
    simply omit this jar, so the AWS SDK stays out of their deployment. Integration tests run against
    Adobe S3Mock (Apache-2.0); MinIO is not used (its server is AGPLv3, ch. 50 decision point 6).

items.title:
io.tesseraql:tesseraql-pdf 0.19.1 发布, Optional printable-documents (pdf) codec for query-export/file-export (roadmap
    Phase 21): Thymeleaf-rendered HTML templates with page-oriented CSS and embedded CJK
    fonts, deterministic output, rendered through openhtmltopdf (the engine adopted at the
    ch. 50 license decision, replaceable behind the module's PdfEngine SPI). Apps that never
    print PDFs simply do not install this jar, so its LGPL dependency stays out of their
    deployment; putting it on the classpath is the whole install (ServiceLoader, design
    ch. 28, 47).
